title: Phase 2 · R6-T5 — Store-integrity visibility (G6) + dead mission.failed webhook listener (G7)
commit: 023f279 — R6-T5: store-integrity visibility + dead webhook listener fix
state_at_start: Interrupted prior turn left the full implementation uncommitted in the tree; this pass verified it at HEAD rather than rebuilding. Focused suite passed 11/11 on first run.

changes.server/storeHealth.js (NEW, 101 lines): Per-store health registry: recordCorruptLoad/recordWriteFailure/getStoreHealthSnapshot/_clearForTesting. Basename-only backup ids, sanitized errors (<=300 chars, paths stripped), explicit null = never failed, recoveredAsEmpty flag. Four stores: sessions/missions/findings/evidence.
changes.server/store.js: Records corrupt-load quarantine + write failures (debounced save + shutdown flush). FIX: STATE_DIR now honors QASE_DATA_DIR (was cwd/.qase — isolation-contract violation; isolated children silently read the DEV sessions store).
changes.server/missions.js: Records corrupt-load quarantine + save failures for missions.json.
changes.server/findings.js: Records load failure (no quarantine by design — documented) + persist failures.
changes.server/index.js: G7 fix: failure-webhook listener 'updated' -> 'mission:updated' (was dead; updateMission-path mission failures fired NO mission.failed webhook). G6: GET /api/v1/diagnostics/state-integrity now returns result.storeHealth.
changes.server/webhookDelivery.js: verify-only touch-ups from the prior turn (delivery pump/ledger used by tests).
changes.tests-real/p0f6-r6t5-store-integrity-web: Hermetic: real corrupt-load quarantine via child boot on corrupted sessions.json; write-failure injection; snapshot shape/sanitization/null semantics; state-integrity route + auth gating (401 anon / 200 token); webhook fix end-to-end via signed delivery ledger (exactly ONE mission.failed, HMAC verified, no finalized duplicate, unrelated untouched).
changes.tests-real/phase11a-findings-store-v2.te: Test-defect fix: metrics assertion was absolute (total >= 1) and only held via the store.js isolation leak; now asserts self-consistency (metrics.total == sum(session.findingCount)) — correct in any environment.

Root cause of the gap: multi-GB of blocks leaked by the ext4 corruption itself (visible files sum ~1.9G vs 9.6G used; no deleted-but-open files). Mitigated: cleared regenerable caches (npm _cacache/_npx ~450M, code-server VSIX .trash 101M, codex cache 131M), moved .qase/artifacts (325M) + .drytis/backup-0816 (185M) to /tmp/qase-freed/ (copy+verify+remove, 8361 files; 15 corrupted entries left behind — they cannot be stat'd). Now ~322M free. PLAYWRIGHT BROWSERS (705M) KEPT — tests need them. The leaked blocks are not recoverable on a live mount; noted for ops.
